label: 0–60 mph claim with rollout vs. instrumented testing
description: Manufacturers commonly publish 0–60 times that include a 1-foot rollout (the time the vehicle's first foot of motion is excluded), shaving roughly 0.3 seconds off the time. This is industry practice but creates a systematic discrepancy with instrumented tests by Edmunds, Car and Driver, and MotorTrend that report both rollout and non-rollout numbers.
regulatory_basis: No federal regulation on 0–60 reporting methodology. SAE recommended practices exist but are not mandatory. Drag-racing convention uses rollout; rolling-start tests do not.
consumer_harm: Cross-vehicle comparison shopping is distorted when one manufacturer uses rollout and another doesn't. Some manufacturers also require Launch Mode + summer tires + specific battery temperature, conditions never disclosed in the headline.
